title: Stop Losing Everything You Save: DFM App #Shorts
description:
We save hundreds of reels, bookmarks, videos and screenshots, and finish almost none. DFM (Don't Forget Me) brings back the things you wanted to see, read, watch and explore before they get forgotten. Save from anywhere, complete, repeat. Available on iOS.

#DFM #DontForgetMe #Productivity #iOSApp #Shorts
